blocks.text: Ordinary-looking steps spend effort across missing stretches of distance.
Location: The Plain of Missing Distance
Appearance: Actual movement leaves alternating foot traces at earlier positions. They wait, catch up to the living feet, and fade. Standing still creates no new trail.
Care: Rest and recovery time help; avoid repeatedly exhausting the affected skill.
Story connection: A future expedition could recover the units lost from an old route measure.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
